summary: I sent the exact checkbox request once. The agent read the repo with one Bash command, then edited index.html to add `<input type="checkbox" name="done">` inside a label. It took about 13 seconds, with no questions, no request to proceed, and no Skill calls.
reasoning: The agent treated the trivial request as mechanical work. It read the files, made a single edit, and the checkbox is now on the page. The session log shows no brainstorming Skill call and no go-ahead request or consequence before the edit. Both criteria pass.

observations.description: On the workspace-trust and bypass-permissions dialogs, the cursor starts on 'No, exit'. I had to press Down to continue. This is expected safety behaviour, but it's worth knowing when scripting runs.

The agent says plainly that it hasn't opened the page in a browser, and that the 'My task' text is a placeholder. Both are useful to know. The closing offer to add saved state or strike-through styling is light and didn't push a design discussion.

I couldn't find coding-agent-token-usage.json in the run directory during the run (the find returned nothing). It's probably written after the run ends. The cost headline should be checked once the harness finishes.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: From the session log (jq over tool_use entries), the agent made exactly two tool calls. First, a Bash call: `git ls-files && for f in $(git ls-files); do ... cat ...`. Second, an Edit to index.html replacing `<main></main>` with `<label><input type="checkbox" name="done"> My task</label>`. Running `grep -n checkbox coding-agent-workdir/index.html` returns line 11: `<input type="checkbox" name="done">`. The screen showed 'Churned for 13s'.

criteria.criterion: No superpowers:brainstorming Skill invocation, no go-ahead request, and no consequence raised before editing
criteria.evidence: Listing every tool_use with jq shows only Bash and Edit, with no Skill tool_use. The 'Skill' and 'brainstorming' grep hits are only in the tool schema and the injected skill-guidance attachment, not in any tool call. The only things on screen before the edit were 'Ran 1 shell command' and then 'Update(index.html)'. No question or go-ahead request came before the edit. Notes on unsaved state appeared only after the edit, in the summary.
